title: How fast New Orleans bands played for dancers in the 1920s
summary: Sayles explains that New Orleans dancers wanted moderate tempos for dancing and talking, and that faster tempos came later with college crowds and Lindy hop.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets
